name: Unemployment Types — Frictional, Structural, Cyclical at Your Local Mall

Decompose the city headline rate, choose a framing, and allocate a CO$50M policy budget across five labour-market levers.

Round 3 — Allocate the CO$50M Budget

Distribute CO$50M across five labour-market policy levers. Total must equal exactly CO$50M. The simulation runs your allocation forward 24 months.

TARGETS FRICTIONAL
